enable_ime_personalized_learning.reason: Flutter applies this only on Android. Its own TextInputConfiguration documents it as 'This flag only affects Android. On iOS, there is no equivalent flag.', and it maps to IME_FLAG_NO_PERSONALIZED_LEARNING. Ignoring it is what the Flutter engine does on Apple, so ignoring it here is exact parity rather than a gap.
